q: How do I make the Project Manager fill the screen?
a: Press **F11** or click the Project Manager's full-screen button. It stays full screen until you quit; at the next launch it opens in a window of its own size again, as Resolve's does. That doesn't touch the editor: opening a project brings the editor back the way you left it.

q: When does a project's tile picture get updated?
a: Every time you save the project: saving takes the frame under the playhead and uses it as the tile's picture in the Project Manager.

q: Why would a project's tile picture come from a second into the first clip?
a: When a project has no picture yet (saved before this version, made by another program or an agent, or saved before its frame was ready), Revolution makes one in the background the first time the Project Manager lists it. It takes the frame at the saved playhead, but when that frame is black it uses a frame a second into the first clip instead. A picture taken by saving is always the frame under the playhead.

q: Does Revolution make the missing project pictures even when my computer is short on memory?
a: It waits. Pictures for projects that don't have one yet are made in the background the first time the Project Manager lists them, and that work pauses while the computer is low on memory. Until a picture arrives the tile shows the faded Revolution logo.

q: Where does the Revolution logo show up in the Project Manager?
a: Where Resolve shows its own: in the Project Manager's title, on the **New Project** tile and at the bottom left of the page bar. A faded logo on a project tile means that project's picture hasn't been made yet.

q: How can an agent open the Project Manager and get the list of projects?
a: Run `projects.show` (File ▸ Project Manager in the Resolve workflow, File ▸ Projects… in the Premiere workflow) to open it, and `projects.list` to read the projects; it takes `folder`, `sort` (`name`, `modified` or `created`), `descending` and `search`.

q: Which app icon does Revolution use out of the box?
a: **Rounded (macOS style)**: a rounded tile with a little margin and a soft shadow, the icon the packages install. Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ **App icon** (Edit ▸ Preferences ▸ Appearance…) switches it to **Square**.

q: Where does Revolution put the app icon it writes on Linux?
a: In your user icon folder, `~/.local/share/icons/hicolor`, because the launcher, taskbar and app switcher take their icon from your icon theme. In a Flatpak it can't write there, so only the window icon changes.

q: Set Revolution up so it starts on the Project Manager and uses the square icon.
a:
1. Edit ▸ Preferences ▸ **General…** (`app.settings.general`): set **At startup show** to **Project Manager**. At launch it opens in a window of its own size; F11 makes it full screen until you quit.
2. Edit ▸ Preferences ▸ **Appearance…**: set **App icon** to **Square**.

The window icon changes at once; the launcher and taskbar icon may need a log-out and back in if your desktop caches icons (in a Flatpak, and on Windows and macOS, those stay rounded).
